_comment: Same root cause as https://github.com/rolldown/rolldown/issues/11344, through star-ambiguity matching. `B.js` reaches `n` through `c.js` and `d.js`; both chains end at `x.js` (one binding). Lazy barrel skips the `c.js -> x.js` record and `e.js`'s `export *` record because nobody requests `n`, so both branches are unknown and must not be reported as AMBIGUOUS_EXTERNAL_NAMESPACES.
